title: Expose imported files and resolve content types safely
context: The import reader currently relies on filename extensions even when the document provider supplies a standard Uniform Type Identifier. The app also lacks a dedicated Files entry in the Agent workspace, making imported-file preview/removal harder to discover.
goal: Resolve supported reader formats from standard content-type identifiers when extensions are unknown, validate payloads with the selected parser, and expose the existing safe imported-file store through a workspace Files screen.
forbidden_changes: Do not bypass JSON/CSV or binary-content validation based on a content-type hint.
Do not execute imported content or treat it as trusted instructions.
Do not expose credentials, model binaries, logs, or cache through the Files screen.
Do not overwrite original imported bytes during preview.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown file extensions can resolve supported formats from standard content-type identifiers.
Regression tests cover JSON, TSV, and malformed JSON with UTI hints.
Agent workspace has a Files surface to import, preview supported content, and remove imported files.
Unsupported preview reports a clear error while preserving the original import.
verification: Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA workflow
Run ImportedFileContentReaderTests including UTI validation cases
recovery: Revert the single task commit if import integrity, reader validation, or workspace navigation regresses.
